theme_stances.key_argument: Reducing forward guidance increases uncertainty and volatility rather than providing better policy signals.

theme_stances.key_argument: Lack of forward guidance from Fed Chair

tension_points.bull_case: Reducing guidance re-injects necessary uncertainty into asset prices and reduces moral hazard, potentially cooling speculative manias.
tension_points.bear_case: Lack of a clear reaction function damages Fed credibility and creates unnecessary market uncertainty, potentially forcing a September hike.
tension_points.what_invalidates: A clear re-establishment of a data-dependent framework by the core committee (Waller, Williams, Jefferson).

tension_points.bull_case: Three hawkish dissents at July FOMC suggest policy is not restrictive enough.
tension_points.bear_case: Chair Warsh emphasizes allowing market pricing to provide signals; market doubting Fed credibility.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Evidence that reserve demand has shifted durably onto the flat portion of the reserve demand curve.
